sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: District Patrol is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Another job for you, warrior. Ever heard of the Cardinal residential complex? That's where you'll be headed. I want to send my boys in, but first we've gotta clear out all the local trash. Think of yourself as the neighborhood cop crashing a rowdy house party."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate any 20 any target using Assault rifles or Assault carbines on Streets of Tarkov

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Prapor Rep +0.25
- 165,000 Roubles
  - 173,250 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 189,750 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
"Already heard you got the job done. Good work, soldier!"

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: In this quest you have to kill any 20 targets on Streets of Tarkov while using Assault rifles or Assault carbines.
